facts.label: My requests
facts.description: The customer's requests (FDD 7.18.4; wireframe Portal requests; replaces customer-my-requests). Chips by what needs the customer, search, a tracker per row; a row opens its tracking page, a ready quote opens the quote. Data: loadRequestsChain (views/customer-my-requests, as the old list).

fields: Request number, customer, contact or contract

chains.name: customersModuleGuardChain
chains.about: Page guard for the CUSTOMERS_MODULE_ENABLED module licence, from Old EquipRite's customer-portal/pages/*-page-chains/customersModuleGuardChain.js. Every customer page runs it first on vbEnter: with the Customers module off it says so and sends the user home, so a bookmark or deep link cannot open a portal page the menu hides. Same copy in every customer page's chains folder. One change: it waits briefly for the flags to load before deciding. The old copy decided at once and, flags still loading on a cold start, sent a licensed user home; it still fails closed if they never arrive. UX layer…

chains.name: enforcePageAccessChain
chains.about: Page-level RBAC deep-link guard. GENERATED - every copy is byte-identical; change the template and regenerate rather than editing one copy. Copies exist because a page's eventListeners resolve a bare chain id against that page's OWN <page>-chains folder, so an app-level chain referenced by name 404s. This file holds NO policy: the decision (canEnterPage), the page code (getPageCodeForPage), the redirect target (getRoleHomeTarget) and the same-flow test (isSameFlow) all live in $application.functions. Deriving the page code at runtime is what lets every copy be identical.

chains.name: filterChain
chains.about: Chip, search text and "Show more". The filtering itself is customer-requests-page.js filterRows.

chains.name: goChain
chains.about: Opens another customer portal page, with the request when one is given (requestId = number, requestNumericId = id, the old customer pages' parameters). Buttons carry data-page / data-id / data-number. Only the portal's own pages; the billing pages only while EXTERNAL_PROJECT_ASSIGN_ENABLED is off (the old nav's hiddenWhenFlags and navigateToMyBillingChain rule). Same copy in every customer page that links to another.

chains.name: loadRequestsChain
chains.about: The customer's requests: Old EquipRite's customer-my-requests-page-chains/EquipmentRequestInitChain.js, same endpoint and parameters (views/customer-my-requests, page 0, size 200) and the same row mapping. Newest first. The view is scoped to the signed-in customer server-side.

modules.name: customerPortal
modules.about: The customer portal's shared logic (New EquipRite, flows/customer): the words a customer sees for each status, the parcel-style tracker, "what needs you next", and the invoice maths. Pure functions, no calls: the chains read and write through the old endpoints and hand the rows here. The invoice part (parseDate … invoiceTotals) is carried over unchanged from Old EquipRite's flows/customer-portal/pages/customer-billing-detail-page-chains/BillingDetailInitChain.js, so a customer sees the same…
